correctness.rationale: Any nonrest configuration fixed by F³ on a connected graph must rotate all vertices through 0→1→2 modulo3; otherwise a resting vertex adjacent to rotating neighbor would be excited. A coloring c rotates iff every vertex has a neighbor of successor color. Fix hub color and use nine states (u_i,v_i); transition M enforces successor neighborhood at subdivision v_i and original rim u_{i+1}, and N removes closed walks with no u_i of successor hub color. Thus P_n=3(tr M^n−tr N^n), including all temporal phases. Independently reconstructed the exact 9×9 matrices from local indicators and computed charpolys x^4(x²+x+1)(x³−2x²−2x−1) and x^6(x+1)(x²−2x−1), yielding the claimed cubic/Pell traces and P_3…P_8=36,84,300,954,2940,8916. Dominant positive cubic root 2.831177… exceeds Pell root 1+√2, proving the asymptotic; 2n+1 vertices give fraction (λ/9)^n. Exhaustive n3..6 stored checks are supportive, matrix identity is infinite proof.

value.rationale: Gear/Jahangir graphs form a natural partially subdivided wheel family, and immediate primitive period-three population is a concrete exact dynamical invariant. A nontrivial nine-state transfer collapses to a cubic law and sharp exponentially small prevalence, an independently useful classification distinct from general activity criteria.

final_claim: For Greenberg–Hastings threshold-one three-state excitation on gear graphs G_n (rim subdivided, spokes not), the exact initial primitive three-periodic population is 3(a_n+ω_n−(−1)^n−b_n), with cubic/Pell recurrences and λ^n growth.
limitations: Only initially primitive temporal period three on labelled gear graphs, no claim on eventual basins, other periods or full historical priority.
residual_risks: Unindexed enumeration of successor-dominating colorings specifically for gear/Jahangir graphs could reproduce this cubic recurrence.
